title: retry needs exponential backoff and last-error re-raise
label: base
prompt: retry() in retry.py must wait with exponential backoff (base_delay doubling after each failed attempt), must not sleep after the final failure, and must re-raise the last exception when all attempts fail. Exceptions listed in `fatal` must propagate immediately without sleeping. Make test_retry.py pass and run python -m pytest -q.

steps.text:
The implementation now satisfies all the requirements:

1. **Exponential backoff**: `delay` starts at `base_delay` and doubles after each failed attempt (`delay *= 2`).
2. **No sleep after final failure**: The sleep only happens when `attempt < attempts - 1`, so it doesn't sleep after the last attempt.
3. **Re-raises last exception**: `last_exc` is tracked and raised when all attempts fail.
